about.title: Hi, I'm Mahmud
paragraphs: I study Computer Science at MISIS in Dushanbe and build automation systems for people who would rather not do the same task twice. My first production system, Simorgh, has been running on a cloud server since September 2026.
I keep things simple on purpose: fewer moving parts, clear code, and documentation good enough that another developer can take over tomorrow.

case.title: Simorgh News: an AI newsroom for a Telegram channel
case.lead: How one person runs a news channel with an AI pipeline, a human review step and a server that never sleeps.
case.problem: Running a news channel alone means reading dozens of sources and rewriting posts every day. It eats hours, and posting stops whenever you are busy.

steps.title: Collect
steps.text: RSS feeds from BBC and Al Jazeera are collected every 30 minutes into a database.

steps.title: Write
steps.text: An LLM rewrites an English article into a Russian post in the channel's voice. If a free model is overloaded, the next one in the chain takes over.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Drafts wait in a web panel and in a Telegram bot. The editor approves, edits or rejects them.

steps.title: Publish
steps.text: Approved posts go to the channel in one click.

case.diagramLabel: Architecture: RSS feeds go to the collector, which stores articles in a database. An LLM writes drafts. The editor reviews them in the web panel or the Telegram bot, and approved posts go to the Telegram channel.
decisions: A human stays in the loop: nothing is published without approval.
Answers that are not in Russian are rejected automatically, because models sometimes leak their reasoning in English.
Any OpenAI-compatible provider works through configuration, so changing providers needs no code changes.
One small cloud server runs the API, the bot, the panel and HTTPS behind Caddy, with Docker Compose.
case.result: Running 24/7 since September 2026: {articles} articles collected and {published} posts published. Publishing a post takes one click.
case.learned: Free AI services change often, so the system must not depend on any single one. Real numbers and a simple review step build more trust than any amount of automation.

sections.text: Nothing by default: no cookies, no analytics and no trackers. Fonts and images are served from this site.

sections.title: The contact form
sections.text: When you send a message, your name, email and text go to my Telegram through my server. They are not stored in a database and are never shared.

sections.title: Bot protection
sections.text: The form uses Cloudflare Turnstile to block spam. It loads only when you start filling in the form and is processed by Cloudflare under its own privacy policy.

sections.title: Live numbers
